description: Native combined root-policy and child-continuation search-aware audit. Preserve broad searched root policy with search-aware targets while adding continuation repair targets.

metadata.previous_result: native-searchaware-override-child-broad-recover-w20-lr2e7-e120 retained child targets after export at 607/690 top1 and 679/690 top3, but corrected native-32 10k search failed: top1 407/1409, 170 candidate-better vs 749 reference-better, capped -70808. Its unified model gate also dropped to 497/1409 top1, proving scalar broad distillation did not preserve searched root policy.
metadata.diagnosis: Child-continuation targets are learnable, but preserving broad behavior through scalar distillation is insufficient. The next hypothesis is to preserve broad root policy directly in the search-aware target set while training child continuations.
metadata.targets: runs/native-searchaware-rootchild-combo-targets-20260525/rootchild_combo_targets.jsonl: 1400 reference-root targets plus 690 broad override-child continuation targets, no duplicate ids.
metadata.hypothesis: A combined search-aware objective can improve child-continuation behavior without erasing the unified root-policy model gate, because reference-root and child-continuation rows now compete inside the same ranking/policy loss.
metadata.gate: Exported .pt/.nn model gate must reach at least 1300/2090 top1 on the combined corpus. If it passes, run the corrected native-32 10k unified search gate before any deeper validation.
metadata.decision: One combined-objective audit only. No SPRT unless the corrected native-32 10k gate beats the original parent reference.

validation.preflight_only: Do not SPRT from this config.
validation.model_gate: Must reach at least 1300/2090 top1 on the combined root-child corpus with exact .pt/.nn parity.
validation.first_search_gate_if_model_passes: Corrected native-32 10k unified search gate against the original parent reference CSV.
validation.hard_stop: No 300k gate and no SPRT unless the corrected native-32 10k gate beats the parent.
